title: memory of a memory
direction: Favor a late-build choreography: sparse medium drops grow into paired and triplet clusters, then one or two larger soft impacts. Preserve the emotional swell rather than following every transient.

sections.name: gather: opening
sections.note: Groups gather through the rise, then release into wider space. Measured note patterns carry the main surface; incidental weather is held behind them.
